**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 5 (deletion becomes the rule) is done; Stage 6 (the one-time deletion) is next.** The goal switch deletes the goal it leaves (`leaveGoal` in `tools/nv/lib/chain.ts`), and no floor is carried, so the status row's percentage counts every check of the goal's record. `bun nv chain --check` fails on a Markdown file naming a goal that is neither on the chain nor a side goal (`goneCitations` in `tools/nv/cmd/chain.ts`); goal prose under `docs/agent/goals/` and the records under `docs/decisions/` are exempt. `docs/agent/session-prompt.md` and `docs/agent/coordinator.md` name the duty to move a goal-prose decision home before `DONE`.

`walkedGoals` stays until Stage 6, because `tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts` and `tools/nv/cmd/plan.ts` read it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names 7 gaps, and each one waits on a question in the goal prose's § *Questions for the user at the goal end*. Do not build the closure rebind, the environment, the zip walk, the captured-output type, directive completion, card voice or completion images before the answers. **No session stops on `BLOCKED` while Stage 6 is open.**

items.text: **Delete the 184 goals in front of `goal-closeout`** — their prose, records and handoff records, and their slugs from `data/chain.json`, in one commit; `bun nv chain --move/--remove` refuse a goal in front of the live one, so the deletion edits the chain record directly. Move any decision only that prose holds to its home first (`docs/agent/goal-decisions.md`). `rule:tooling/the-chain-names-its-live-goal`, anchored at `tools/nv/lib/chain.ts:101`.

**Fix the citations the deletion leaves** — `bun nv chain --check` then names about 70 places that cite a deleted goal by slug: `docs/implementation-plan.md`, `docs/plan/m*.md`, `docs/reference/findings.md`, `docs/agent/loop-authoring.md` and a few playbook bullets. Each sentence names the rule or module doc instead. `rule:tooling/the-chain-names-its-live-goal`, anchored at `tools/nv/cmd/chain.ts:76`.

**`walkedGoals` goes** — `tools/nv/lib/chain.ts:115` and its header at `tools/nv/lib/chain.ts:6`, its readers at `tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts:282`, `tools/nv/cmd/plan.ts:222` and `tools/nv/cmd/plan.ts:325`, and its test at `tools/nv/test/chain.test.ts:76`. `rule:tooling/the-chain-names-its-live-goal`.

backlog: Stage 4's red checks wait on the user's answers to the 7 questions in `docs/agent/goals/goal-closeout.md`; the session that finds them the only red ones writes `BLOCKED` and names that section.
`tools/nv/test/records.test.ts:25` and `tools/nv/test/import.test.ts:210` still use a stage titled `floor` as fixture data; it is harmless, and renaming it is optional.
